## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what was wrong or missing and what users can do after this change.

## Validation

List the relevant checks actually run and their results. For UI changes, include desktop/mobile screenshots when useful. Explain any meaningful unverified behavior.

## Review notes

Mention schema/configuration changes, migrations or remaining limits. Follow the current [architecture](../docs/architecture/current.md) and [UX direction](../docs/ux-refresh.md). Keep secrets, real user data and generated tooling out of the diff.
